g.text: When a door is shut to you
A refused trip opens a small Access Shop for the token you need. Use now buys it and the trip goes ahead.
You need access to go to BSP-Wilds.
Also sold at: the Spawn Market, next to the bank.
No price set yet. Sold at the Spawn Market, next to the bank.
A token without a price shows where to buy it instead.
A player with no main server is asked first. One choice, free, for ever. Your base goes there and you always have access.
Choose BSP-Forest as your main server?
